card.name: Just before a term is named
card.fires_on: Small words in phrases that introduce a label, such as 'what the CDC calls', 'as it would come to be known' or 'referred to as'. It fires right before the name itself.

modes.label: what X calls
modes.description: Words after 'what' and before a verb like 'call', introducing a term someone uses.
modes.example: 14 states are reporting what<< the>> CDC calls "regional activity."

modes.label: referred to as
modes.description: Verb or adverb parts of 'referred to as' or 'known as' that define a label.
modes.example: These three presentations are<< referred>> to as GVOKE in this labeling

card.writes: It promotes words meaning 'called' or 'termed', mostly Chinese ones, so the model expects a naming phrase next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say that something is called by a certain name.
